plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-13 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Graphic Design program page (poid=10852) and its linked official degree map, 'Graphic Design Degree Maps (2026-2027)', tab 'Graphic Design (Campus)' (the workbook has no Online tab; its Index lists Online as N/A), last updated/reviewed August 3, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Per the catalog, all courses must be passed with a C (2.0) or better to be counted in the major, transfer students must earn at least 50% of their art credits from SUU, and students accepted into the program through the Program Application Review must have their own laptop capable of running professional design software; the map prints a 'BFA Program Application Due' marker in Fall Year 2 (no course, no credits, not recorded as a course row). Every semester's courses sum to the map's printed semester total (16/16/15/15/15/15/13/15) and the plan to the catalog's printed Total Credits, BFA Degree: 120. The catalog's Graphic Design Curriculum (79 credits) is exercised exactly by the map: BFA Art Foundation 25 (every named course placed, including ARTH 2710 and ARTH 2720, which also carry GE Humanities tags); Graphic Design Requirements 39 (every named course placed, with the Complete One of the Following art-history choice exercised as the map's Spring Year 3 upper-division art history slot, and ART 4890 Internship recorded at the 3 credits the catalog requires of its 0.5-12 range); Portfolio Development Options 9 (the map's three 3-credit portfolio rows); Art Electives 6 (the map's two 3-credit ART/ARTH elective rows). DISCLOSED, not placed: the catalog's Graphic Design Requirements block also lists a Senior BFA Exhibition at 0 credits; it carries no course code in the catalog and has no row on the map, so it is recorded here rather than as a course row (0 credits, so no total is affected). The map's free-elective rows total 16 credits as printed (3/3/1/9); the catalog prints no free-elective figure, and its recommended electives COMM 2010 and CSCY 2000 are the annotations printed on the map's Fall Year 3 and Spring Year 3 free-elective rows. Catalog course titles are recorded where the map shortens them (ART 4790 Senior BFA Studio I: Professional Practices and Portfolio Systems; ART 4800 Senior BFA Studio II: BFA Exhibition and Portfolio Completion).
